title: Longer-scale deceleration structure does not establish robust incremental age transfer across public RR collections
abstract: A four-beat-scale deceleration-anchor contrast did not establish robust incremental age prediction across two public RR collections. Fantasia-to-NSR2 loss improved by 0.022080 (joint-refit 95% interval [-0.020030, 0.074992]), but AUC improved only 0.002326 and reverse loss worsened by 0.001567. After target-label oracle intercept recalibration the forward gain became -0.003660. The result is exploratory, calibration-sensitive and not a validated physiological-aging biomarker; participant overlap remains unknown.
